verdict.rationale: Mistral Document AI is an API-based document processing product, and an in-product assistant is a fair axis for it. The evidence shows only a Document QnA API capability for asking questions about documents. That is a developer building block, not a built-in assistant users can delegate tasks to. The Le Chat mention concerns a separate Mistral product, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: The Document QnA capability combines OCR with large language model capabilities to enable natural language interaction with document content.
